grc:noun:θεωρός.html:
θεωρός, ὁ (v. infr.),
envoy sent to consult an oracle, , ; to present an offering, Orac. ap. ; to be present at festivals, θεωροὺς εἰς τὰ Πύθια πέμψαι, cf. , etc.
generally, envoy, sent to kings regarded as divine, , .
title of a magistrate at Mantinea, ; at Naupactus, (pl.), cf. ib. (found in Ceos); at Thasos, ib., etc.
spectator, , , , ; πολέμου, etc.; opp. ἀγωνιστής, ; one who travels to see men and things, , ; also λαμπάδα θ. εἰκάδων (lyr., s.v.l.). (Uncontr.θεαορός (Orchom. , iv B.C.): contr.θεαρός in Dor. (, etc.), ( (Tegea), etc.): θεουρός Thess. (): θευρός Thas. (. l.c.); θιαρός Corc. ().) (Perh. fr. θεα-ηορϝος, cf. θεη-κόλος and θυρωρός (
